$comment: herdr workspace layout for this project — see https://herdr.dev.
Opened with `just workspace` (or `herdr-up` from anywhere inside the repo).
This is herdr's own LayoutNode tree, not a Diixtra invention: a binary tree of
'split' nodes (direction right|down, ratio 0..1) and 'pane' leaves. That means
herdr's docs are the reference, and a layout you arrange by hand can be dumped
with the socket API's layout.export and pasted straight in here.
${REPO}, ${REPO_NAME} and ${HOME} are expanded when the layout is applied, so
this file does not care where the repo is cloned.
Every pane sets cwd explicitly and on purpose: herdr fixes cwd at creation and
has no workspace.set_cwd, so a pane that omits it inherits $HOME and stays
Edit freely — this is a starting point per repo, not a standard to preserve.
Delete the file to fall back to the machine-wide default.

second.label: git
command: command -v watch >/dev/null && watch -n 2 -c "git -c color.ui=always status -sb; echo; git -c color.ui=always diff --stat"; exec ${SHELL:-zsh}
